30.A..apl.532.2023.Judgment.odt 4.

By preferring this application, the applicant prayed for quashing of the First Information Report (hereinafter referred to as 'FIR') vide Crime No.101/2018 registered at Police Station Shirkhed,
Amravati (Rural) for the offence punishable under Section 420, 406 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code against the applicant and the other co-accused.

5. The offence is registered on the basis of a report lodged by the non-applicant No.2 Mahesh Vitthalrao Hiwase on an allegation that the applicant is the uncle of Atual Sahabrao Lavhale who is the resident of Amravati.
The father-in-law of the present applicant is the owner of the agricultural field at Dhangarkhed and also running a Nursery duly registered with the Government of Maharashtra vide registration No.32.
The nephew of the present applicant Atul Sahebrao Lavhale was cultivating the agricultural field of his family and also running the business of turmeric crop.

The offence was registered against him and other co-accused on an allegation that he had approached to the non-applicant No.2 and other cultivators with the proposal of purchase of their turmeric crop on the price higher than the market price.
It was represented to non-applicant No.2 and other agriculturist that after processing turmeric he will export the same and thereby would earn huge profits.

Thus, by misrepresenting the non-applicant No.2 said Atul Sahebrao Lavhale purchased turmeric from the cultivators,
30.A..apl.532.2023.Judgment.odt

however, did not pay the sale price of turmeric to them and,
therefore, non-applicant No.2 had lodged the report at Shirkhed, Amravati (Rural) Police Station on 19/04/2018 vide Crime No.101/2018 under the above provisions of law.

6. Heard learned Senior counsel for the applicant, learned APP for the State as well as learned counsel for the non-applicant No.2.
7.

It is submitted by the learned Senior counsel that only allegation against the present applicant is that being he is the uncle of the other co-accused Atul Sahebrao Lavhale, the complainant approached to him, but he has not disclosed the whereabouts of the said Atul.
Thus, the present applicant in furtherance of the common intention involved in the said offence.
He submitted that in fact from the allegation itself, no prima facie case is made out against him.
Merely because he is the family member of the co-accused, he is implicated in the alleged offence and therefore, the application deserves to be allowed.

8. Per contra, learned APP strongly opposed the said contention and submitted that considering the allegation levelled against the present applicant and various agriculturist are deceived by the nephew of the present applicant.
There is allegation that present applicant has not disclosed the whereabouts of the co-accused and considering the same, the Subhashrao Govindrao Lavhale vs State Of Mah. Thr. Pso, Ps Shirkhed, ...

applicant is also joining hands with the co-accused.
In view of that, the application deserves to be rejected.
9. Learned counsel for the non-applicant No.2/complainant also endorsed the same contention.
10. The applicant is the uncle of Atul Sahebrao Lavhale.

As far as the allegations are concerned, only allegation levelled against him is that when the agriculturist had been to the house of said Atul, the applicant was present there and he has not disclosed his whereabouts.
The co-accused has already deceived the various cultivators by purchasing turmeric crop from them and not paid them the amount.
Thus, the co-accused has earned huge profits accordingly, the various cultivators were deceived by him.
In view of that, considering the involvement of the present applicant, he was implicated as per the allegations.

But on perusal of the entire investigation papers, except the allegation that the various cultivators visited the place of the other co-accused, he was present there and he has not disclosed the whereabouts of the other co-accused is the only allegation.
In such circumstances, allowing the proceeding against the present applicant to continue will be an abuse of the process of law.
As no allegations are levelled against the present applicant, the power under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. needs to be used and proceeding against him needs to be quashed and set aside.
In 30.A..apl.532.2023.Judgment.odt view of that, the application deserves to be allowed.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass following order:
ORDER (i) The application is allowed.
(ii) The First Information Report in connection with Crime No.101/2018 registered at Police Station Shirkhed, Amravati (Rural) for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 406 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and consequent proceeding arising out of the same bearing RCC No.193/2021 pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Morshi, are hereby quashed and set aside to the extent of the present applicant.
The application is disposed of.
(URMILA JOSHI-PHALKE, J) Sarkate.
